messages:
maya_fin: Heads-up — seeing invoice allocation splits applied incorrectly after plan changes overnight. Example: acct=8165 invoice=5567 allocated 100% to old plan instead of split old/new. ~12 affected so far. Anyone seen webhook/order-of-events problems?

tomas_int: On it. Is this tied to proration or quantity changes? Anything common across invoices?

maya_fin: Mostly proration from plan change + immediate usage events in same billing cycle. First spotted 2026-03-21 03:00 UTC.

ashley_billing: We had a NetSuite sync retry job yesterday — DLQ had 9 invoice events that were reprocessed. Could be causing re-ordering.

ashley_billing: logs snippet:
```
retries: 9
dlq_messages: ["evt_1GkA... invoice:5567 updated", "evt_1GkB... invoice:5567 created"]
processor: netsuite-sync-v2
status: retried_at=2026-03-21T03:12:10Z
```

billing-bot: sync-job-processor retried 9 events from DLQ at 2026-03-21T03:12:10Z (run_id=run_20260321_0312) :warning:

ashley_billing: The DLQ items show create/update arriving reversed for at least 3 invoices. Our connector uses standard SQS (not FIFO) so order isn't guaranteed on retry.

tomas_int: That explains it. Our invoice handler assumes create -> update ordering. Quick mitigation: make handler idempotent and use invoice.revision or invoice.lines checksum to detect newer state before applying allocations.

maya_fin: Short term: can we run a reconciliation to reallocate revenue lines? Which script would you use?

ashley_billing: I have a backfill: `scripts/alloc_reconcile.py --since 2026-03-20 --filter=plan-change --dry-run`. It compares Stripe invoice lines vs NetSuite allocation records and emits a repair plan. Need prod run approval and invoice lock during apply.

maya_fin: Approved for prod run after dry-run confirms scope. Please post affected invoice list here.

ashley_billing: dry-run output (sample):
```
affected_invoices: [5567, 5572, 5581, 5599, 5603]
reason: invoice.updated processed before invoice.created -> allocations not recalculated
recommended_action: apply_reallocation_patch for each invoice id
```

ashley_billing: Plan: dry-run now, full backfill 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC, create compensating journal entries if allocation diffs > $1000, mark invoices locked during apply.

maya_fin: Sounds good. Please tag billing ops tickets and CC finance for any manual JE.

tomas_int: I'll push a small hotfix to webhook processor: ensure we (1) dedupe by stripe_event_id, (2) check invoice.metadata.revision or invoice.lines hash before applying, and (3) write ordering trace to the event log. Deploying canary to staging now.

ashley_billing: After canary validation, I'll run the backfill. Will update with counts and amount corrected.

sneha_sre: Ping me if you need runbook help or temporary maintenance windows. Also recommend adding an alert: invoices where sum(allocations) != invoice.total -> trigger high-severity page for finance ops.

maya_fin: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated when backfill completes and when hotfix is in prod.
